dev.description: Start the reference app dev server
dev.template: Run dev server for the reference app. Use `pnpm --filter <app-name> dev` to start the Astro dev server.

check.description: Run full check pipeline on the reference app
check.template: Run the full validation pipeline on the reference app. Execute `pnpm --filter <app-name> check`, then `pnpm --filter <app-name> astro:check` for TypeScript/Astro type checking.

build.description: Full build of the reference app
build.template: Build the reference app for production. Run `pnpm --filter <app-name> build` which runs the full build.prepare → astro:check → astro build → build.post pipeline.

lint:tokens.description: Run design token linting on the reference app
lint:tokens.template: Run design system token linting. Execute `pnpm --filter <app-name> tokens:ds:lint` to check for non-ds tokens, and `pnpm --filter <app-name> tokens:colors:lint` to check for hardcoded colors.

gen:icons.description: Regenerate icon components from LordIcon JSON
gen:icons.template: Regenerate all icon components from packages/ui JSON sources. Execute `pnpm exec site-kernel run icons.generate` from the repository root.

validate.description: Run content + thin-copy validation on the reference app
validate.template: Validate content surface. Run `pnpm --filter <app-name> content:validate` and `pnpm --filter <app-name> thin-copy:validate`.

compass.template: Run Compass inventory and validation. Execute `pnpm exec site-kernel run compass.inventory` then `pnpm exec site-kernel run compass.validate`.

format.template: Run prettier formatting on the entire workspace. Execute `pnpm format`.

sync.description: Run astro sync for type generation
sync.template: Regenerate Astro content collection types. Execute `pnpm --filter <app-name> astro sync`.
